description.value:
You draw upon the collective's knowledge of every mind the gestalt memory contains, sharpening your own cognition into a razor's edge. You gain a +2 status bonus to Will saving throws. Additionally, choose one of the following abilities: you can use your Wisdom modifier in place of your Intelligence modifier for all Intelligence-based skill checks, you can use your Wisdom modifier in place of your Strength modifier for Athletics checks, or you gain a +2 status bonus to Perception checks.

Heightened (4th) The status bonus to Will saving throws increases to +3, and you may choose two abilities from the list instead of one.

Heightened (6th) You gain all three abilities simultaneously, and the status bonus to Will saving throws increases to +3.

Heightened (9th) All status bonuses from this spell increase by 1 (maximum +4 to Will saves, +3 to Perception).
